body.focus: Both build-gate judge prompts (src/daemon/steps/build-step/render.ts renderStandaloneValidatePrompt and src/prompts/build/validate-task.md) let the judge read the repository with read-only commands as well as read tools, still telling it not to run the typecheck or tests and not to change anything, so a codex judge can read. A trivial standalone build's validate prompt carries the build's stated scope (the standalone focus), passed from src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/validate.ts. The prompt test pinning the old wording is updated; tests show both prompts permit read-only commands and the trivial prompt includes the scope. Implements ISSUE-ae2d83c6ab06c595.
body.summary: Commit 687395c8: both judge prompts allow read-only commands (cat, rg, ls, git diff, git log) beside read tools and still forbid running the typecheck/tests or changing anything; a trivial standalone prompt renders the focus as "## Stated scope" (passed from phases/validate.ts). Tests: render.test.ts (wording + scope section) and build-start.test.ts (the trivial validate passes the focus to the judge); four falsifying mutations each fail a test. Full sweep: the same 2 pre-existing failures as before (sqlite-driver, review-decision), nothing new. Live: on the daemon at 687395c8 the codex judge read the repository and judged the change.
